topic: Deal Sheet: два финансирования за сутки — Pure DC $780M и тайский кампус $590M

sources.title: Thai AI data center secures US$ 590 million loan to fund construction
facts: Haoyang Data Centre 1 (Thailand) Limited (HYDC1), a member of the target acquisition group of Hong Kong-listed Zhi Sheng Group Holdings, secured a seven-year US$590 million loan from a Thai bank
Funds construction of a hyperscale AI data center in Thailand's Eastern Economic Corridor
In July 2026 HYDC1 signed a 10-year colocation agreement with a leading internet company worth about US$1.6 billion excluding electricity charges
The contract is roughly one-third of expected total rental revenue at full completion
Phased delivery in 2027; capacity in MW not stated

sources.title: Pure DC secures $780m to fund data centre expansion across Europe, Middle East
facts: Pure DC secured a $780 million Platform Growth Facility with an option to raise borrowing by a further $1.1 billion, for a potential total of about $1.9 billion
New lenders: Citigroup Global Markets, First Abu Dhabi Bank, Infranity; existing lenders: ABN AMRO, Allianz Global Investors, SMBC
Supports the wider pipeline (site acquisitions, new projects) rather than a single campus, across Europe and the Middle East
Pure DC prioritises locations where sufficient electricity capacity can be secured
Pure DC says it has arranged more than $6.2 billion in financing over the past 12 months
Seinäjoki, Finland: phase one 110MW of IT capacity, fully leased
MW under construction (published capacity only): Finland 850; Thailand 715; United Arab Emirates 430

caption:
$780M and $590M: two data center financings in two days.

Pure DC (Oaktree-backed) secured a $780 million platform facility with an option to reach about $1.9 billion, backed by new and existing lenders and aimed at sites with secured power across Europe and the Middle East.

In Thailand, HYDC1 raised a seven-year $590 million bank loan for a hyperscale AI campus in the Eastern Economic Corridor, with a roughly $1.6 billion 10-year colocation contract already signed. Thailand has 715 MW under construction in our pipeline tracker.

Data: Coloprice pipeline tracker, 6 Nov 2026. Sources: W.Media, Data Centre Review.
